name: grid-subgrid-automatic-span-empty-name-groups
derivation: Four local line groups, including two empty groups, specify three explicit tracks. With both column placements auto the subgrid therefore spans parent columns1-3, width13+19+29=61. The following sibling takes column4 at x61. Local mid is line2 and end is line4, so the descendant starts at x13 and spans19+29=48px. Empty name groups count as lines rather than disappearing.
